title: The crow on the seawall
logline: The crow, close, on the seawall, August. Vol 7's crow. The page gives it the bird's page — the piling composition — and the crow is black in a page of ochre.

panels.composition: The crow on the seawall in August, close, the composition of the bird's piling page: one bird, one wall, the bay dissolving. The crow entirely black, the only black on a page of warm ochre.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a black crow perched on a concrete seawall in warm August light with a bay dissolving into haze behind, the crow the only black on the page, no words
image.notes: The bird's composition (ro_2022-09-18) given to the crow.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The crow gets the bird's page.
